title: Generalizable Multi-Agent Planning from Signal Temporal Logic Specifications via Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2608.29490v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-agent systems in the real-world (e.g., drone swarms, autonomous cars, warehouse robots) must satisfy rich, temporal tasks while avoiding collisions. Signal Temporal Logic (STL) elegantly encodes such objectives, but current STL planning methods face critical limitations. State-of-the-art optimization-based approaches can handle arbitrary STL specifications but struggle with scalability, becoming computationally impractical as the number of agents grows. Learning-based methods efficiently handle a large number of agents with rapid planning times but fare poorly when deployment-time objectives differ from those used during training, and do not support planning tasks that require different specifications to be ascribed to different agents (i.e., heterogeneity) or team-level specifications requiring coordination of multiple agents. translated_title: 基于扩散模型的信号时序逻辑规范驱动的可泛化多智能体规划
translated_abstract: 现实世界中的多智能体系统（如无人机集群、自动驾驶汽车、仓储机器人）必须在避免碰撞的同时满足丰富的时序任务。信号时序逻辑（STL）能够优雅地编码此类目标，但当前的STL规划方法面临关键局限。最先进的基于优化的方法可以处理任意的STL规范，但在可扩展性方面存在困难，随着智能体数量的增加，计算上变得不切实际。基于学习的方法能够以快速的规划时间高效处理大量智能体，但当部署时的目标与训练时使用的目标不同时表现不佳，并且不支持需要将不同规范分配给不同智能体的规划任务（即异构性），也不支持需要多个智能体协调的团队级规范。可泛化性与可扩展性之间的这一根本性权衡，为实现（摘要在此处截断）带来了挑战。
tldr: 该论文提出利用扩散模型从信号时序逻辑规范出发实现多智能体规划，旨在同时兼顾可扩展性与泛化能力，并支持异构规范分配和团队级协调任务。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a diffusion-based approach for multi-agent planning from Signal Temporal Logic specifications, aiming to balance scalability and generalizability while supporting heterogeneous specifications and team-level coordination.
